Only this file exists as `*AgentTest.java` in the project currently, and all 43 tests pass.

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/reflect/TypeUtilsAgentTest.java`, a self-contained JUnit 5 test class covering `TypeUtils`: type-variable detection, `determineTypeArguments` (same-class, hierarchy, incompatible, null checks), `equals` across all `Type` kinds, array/component type helpers, implicit bounds, `getRawType` (including the unknown-`Type` error path), `getTypeArguments` overloads, `isArrayType`, `isAssignable` (classes, parameterized, wildcard/type-variable/generic-array targets, and the unhandled-type `IllegalStateException`), `isInstance`, `normalizeUpperBounds`, `parameterize`/`parameterizeWithOwner` (including error cases), `toString`/`toLongString`, `typesSatisfyVariables`, `unrollVariables`, the `WildcardTypeBuilder`/`WILDCARD_ALL`, `wrap`, and the deprecated public constructor.
